source.upstream_graph_reset: ../gbplanner/src/rrg.cpp:1078-1085 resets exploration/adaptive samplers on each graph build.
source.upstream_reseeding: ../planner_common/src/random_sampler.cpp:134-136 and 242-247 reseed the main and four axis generators from std::random_device; upstream does not preserve one uninterrupted RNG stream between builds.
source.ros2_adaptation: SamplingSeedSequence uses effective_seed = (base_seed + request_index) modulo 2^32 in sequence mode. This deterministic schedule replaces fresh entropy and is not bit-equivalent to upstream sampling.

lifetime.advance: One request index is consumed when a local planning attempt enters beginLocalSampling, including attempts that later fail or are rejected inside LocalPlanner. Fixed mode also increments the recorded index.
no_advance: retained global route without local planning
lifetime.seed_cycle: Sequence seeds repeat after 2^32 requests; the uint64 request index distinguishes repetitions.
lifetime.index_exhaustion: Index UINT64_MAX can be returned once; the next call throws std::overflow_error without wrapping.
lifetime.restart: The node-owned sequence starts again at request index zero after node restart.
lifetime.observability: sampling_status publishes mode, base_seed, effective_seed, request_index, caller and map_revision; ordinary planning metrics also identify the effective seed and request index.
